reason: Unauthenticated RCE on Windows-hosted servers only (advisory published 2026-08-25, CVSS 9.0). The web service runs in Railway's Linux containers. Revisit before any move to a Windows host.

RCE when an AVIF file is optimized (advisory published 2026-08-25, CVSS 9.5). The image optimizer has no source an attacker controls: next.config.js sets no images.remotePatterns/domains/loader and the only next/image use is one local PNG logo. An inference from our configuration, not a statement in the advisory — so the precondition is checked on every run. Real fix: upgrade next to 15.5.24.
